basis: The dashboard presents a direct, unresolvable conflict between two encodings of the same metric, `market_share`. The printed data labels (Apple 30%, Samsung 11%, Xiaomi 11%, Huawei 23%, Others 25%) identify Apple as the highest value. However, the plotted bar heights against the y-axis (Huawei ~63, Xiaomi ~48, Apple ~34, Others ~25, Samsung ~7) identify Huawei as the highest value. Because the chart itself contains these contradictory signals and provides no legend or note to establish which representation is the authoritative source of truth for the decision metric, the current market-share leader cannot be determined from the evidence.
